subject: Excruciating slow exchange with Google Drive for shiny app

messages.author: 877cd740823aa09d
messages.subject: Excruciating slow exchange with Google Drive for shiny app
parts:
Wondering if anyone else has noticed a change in speed.   I have a shiny app running since last September that allows users to upload Excel files to shiny app running on shinyapps.io.   

We were living with a slow (40 second) exchange between the shiny app and Google Drive but now that time has quadrupled.    R version is the same since the fall (3.3.2).    Other functionality of the app seems just as fast as ever

A timing script I wrote in June now completely fails to complete writing a series of data chunks (rows by 55 columns, increasing as 35, 70, .... to 350.)    In June, I could write 350 rows in 400 seconds, now the script is taking so long I am killing the job (more than an hour).    I can write 35 rows in 2.4 minutes and 70 rows in 8.5 minutes (compared to June:  21 and 40 seconds) and it will take many hours to complete the incremental steps up to 350 rows.

thanks
